properties/step_id: One-based history step to retrieve. Omit to search or list saved steps; required for selecting parts or a call_id.
properties/call_id: Tool-call ID within the selected step. With section=all returns its observation; with tool_calls or tool_results selects that call's entries. Cannot combine with sections or other section values.
properties/section: One original part to retrieve from step_id; defaults to all. user returns that step's new user messages. Cannot combine with sections.
properties/sections: Nonempty array of distinct original part names to retrieve together from step_id. Cannot combine with section or call_id; returns complete parts without paging.
properties/query: Case-insensitive text to search across complete history and summaries when step_id is omitted; an empty query lists all steps.
